text:
deploybot: alert: embeddings-cost threshold breached in ap-northeast-1. automated rollback to v2.6.3 scheduled in 12m unless acknowledged. :warning:

anya: I see it in the dashboard, embed_cost_p95 ~2.5x. no customer errors yet. is this only embeddings route?

dev-tom: yes only /v1/embeddings. recent change toggled packed-kernel experiment. suspect regression there.

ops-lee: auto-rollback timer at 9m. options: full revert to v2.6.2 image or try targeted kernel toggle revert on canary then progressive.

sre-rachel: prefer canary-first. if canary improves by >50% cost we can propagate. i'll monitor cost and p90 latency.

anya: please hold auto-rollback for 15m to allow canary test. suppressing now. reason=canary_probe_by_engineering

deploybot: suppression applied; expires in 15m.

dev-tom: running canary revert on pool ap-northeast-canary now:
```bash
rdwctl pool update ap-northeast-canary --env "PACKED_KERNEL=off"
rdwctl rollout status ap-northeast-canary
```

sre-rachel: watching metrics stream. key panels: embed_cost_per_1k_tokens, embed_p90_latency, tenant_error_rate.

(4m later)

sre-rachel: canary cost down ~68%, latency unchanged. good signal.

ops-lee: propose progressive rollout 10% steps every 90s across shards, set temporary pin to v2.6.2 for 8h to avoid flip-flop, and update release notes.

pm-noah: PMs agree to pin + comms. legal-bot: loop me for billing-facing wording.

legal-bot: acknowledged. provide affected tenant list when ready.

dev-tom: executing progressive rollout and applying pin:
```bash
rdwctl rollout config ap-northeast-1 --set PACKED_KERNEL=off --steps 10 --interval 90s
rdwctl pin set service:embeddings ap-northeast-1 --version 2.6.2 --duration 8h --reason "mitigate embed cost regression"
```

deploybot: staged rollout started; auto-rollback remains suppressed until pin expiry. temporary_threshold raised to avoid noisy triggers.

sre-rachel: at 50% rollout cost down ~60% region-wide, no errors. continuing monitor.

anya: thanks team. i'll add release note: "temporary rollback of packed-kernel experiment and pinned embeddings runtime in ap-northeast-1 to address cost regression." will open follow-up to add kernel test to canary suite. :thumbsup:

deploybot: suppression will auto-expire after pin duration. thread closed unless new signals appear.
